'''Fiddlehead Risotto''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

'''Note:''' this recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] - it will result in profit when using the lowest quality ingredients and made with homemade [[Oil]].

[[File:Shirt172.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].
